'''Kyla Latrel''' was an ambitious [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who worked for [[Tampson Consolidated, Incorporated]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] period. She took part in the [[Vor-cal]] shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Expanse" />
